step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows traffic entering from an Alias to a Network Load Balancer (NLB), which routes requests using Overlay IPs managed in AWS VPC Route Tables to SAP instance clusters across two Availability Zones (AZs). Primary AZ components include ASCS, PAS, and SAP HANA DB. Secondary AZ components include ERS, AAS, and a standby SAP HANA DB with active replication.

graph.name: Whirlpool SAP High Availability Architecture on AWS
graph.notes: SAP Extended Warehouse Management deployed across two AZs using NLB, VPC Overlay IPs, and HANA System Replication.
